label: SXT R
description: MikroTik SXT R (RBSXTR) — 2x 100M RJ45. MIPSBE 1-core QCA9531.
notes: Port roles from MikroTik's own spec table: **PoE in 802.3af/at** (12-57 V) through the single DC input, and **PoE-out ports: Ether2** (passive PoE up to 57 V, 600 mA low-voltage / 400 mA high-voltage limit). The prose says the *second* port carries PoE-out, so `eth1` is the drop that powers the unit. `eth2` is now marked as the PSE side; the outgoing port has a current limit and no wattage budget, hence `poe.budgetUnknown`. **MikroTik publishes no max power consumption for RBSXTR** - neither the product spec table nor the SXT R document (#50019) prints one - so `eth1` records no PD draw rather than a class number dressed as a datasheet figure. `poeIn` was therefore left off, not guessed.
